Prerequisites: —

You can expend MGP to assign the Dimmed status effect to one target and the Blinded status effect to another, both within 30 feet of you. Once assigned, each target may attempt a Will saving throw to negate the effect. The duration of these effects is equal to the amount of MGP expended in rounds. At the start of your next turn, you may sustain the effects on the same targets (no additional saving throw required) or assign new targets as a free action. If an affected creature moves beyond this gambit's range, the effect ends for that creature.
